column1: # Size families: one row a size. These are the figures the scaling laws, the
# family comparisons and the reference wings are measured against.
# Sources: the published specification tables of Ozone, PHI, BGD and
#   Skywalk and, for total_line_m, the makers'
#   own line sheets where this folder holds them.
# Retrieved: not recorded when this table was first written. The unit suite
#   checks it against a separate transcription of the makers' tables,
#   published-specs.tsv, and against the line sheets.
# measure: as-published, except total_line_m as below
# total_line_m is the cord in the lineset — both sides, risers not included:
#       summed from the line sheet of each size in this folder: quantity x
#       sewn length over every row. line_pieces is the count.
#       summed from BGD's production line sheets for the S, M, ML and L: twice
#       the 121 lines of one side. No XS sheet is held, so that cell is blank.
#       the maker's published figure. No line sheet for these is held, so
# BGD also publish a "Total line length" — 209, 226, 247, 268 and 290 m — and
# until 2026-10-06 this column held it. It is in published-specs.tsv now. It
# is 10.7 m for every square metre of flat area at all five sizes, so it goes
# with the SQUARE of the scale factor BGD state, where their line sheets, and
# the line height they publish beside it, go with the factor itself. At the L
# it says 290 m, and the sheet adds up to 262.7 m.
